items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for fleet-wide go-live, new public exposure, and security-sensitive releases; ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Evidence: security covers 61 managed sites, but fleet-doctor has no run, checks, findings, or site results; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results; and authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance is technical-only with 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown. No clean bill of health, exploit result, credential exposure finding, or certification is supported. Recommendation: preserve existing private-launch and security-sensitive release gates and continue only the existing read-only evidence matrix; do not change credentials or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, access private containers, exploit targets, or request duplicate telemetry.
